description: This Java source file defines the JMSConnectionHandlingActor class, an Akka actor responsible for managing JMS Connections and Sessions for IBM Qpid JMS client within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for establishing, recovering, closing, and disconnecting JMS connections, creating consumers, creating sessions, handling exceptions, and maintaining session state. The actor operates asynchronously, with blocking operations assigned to a dedicated dispatcher.

classes.name: JMSConnectionHandlingActor
classes.description: An Akka actor managing the lifecycle of JMS connections and sessions for messaging, handling connection, recovery, closure, disconnection, and consumer creation, with thread-safe operations and error handling.
